scope: Four source-conditioned ceramic appearance recipes using the existing A12 material field engine. No material test, calibrated optical measurement, or mechanical calibration was performed. New reference profiles use original semantic surface tags and explicit field-kernel version 2.

implementation.coordinate_contract: All material fields are sampled in the same mother millimetre coordinates. Original surface faces query at zero depth by semantic tag; volume samples require explicit depth_mm. Query-time sampling is deterministic and draws no randomness.

coating_surface_policy.foot_base_policy: style-specific; these profiles leave foot and base bare

field_kernel.name: value_noise+aggregate+fiber;splitmix64-logical-u64-v2
field_kernel.reason: Version 1 signed arithmetic shifts capped lattice values below 0.5, making the existing 0.62 pore threshold unreachable.
field_kernel.legacy_profiles: Profiles without field_kernel_version retain version 1 for asset replay.

global_evidence_boundary.coating_surface_depth_semantics: Semantic original-surface query at depth 0; no physical glaze thickness is inferred.
global_evidence_boundary.field_kernel_v2: New reference profiles only; old catalogue profiles and assets remain on version 1.
